purpose: SPoM is a 3D Slicer extension that provides a C++ CLI module, PoissonShapeAnalysis. It compares two folders of binary shape volumes using Poisson-equation statistical shape analysis (Gao & Bouix, 2016) and outputs a mean-shape volume and model for researchers.
summary: I read the catalog entry, the top-level and module CMake files, the CLI source and XML, the IO and VTK utilities, and the license. Only the CLI module is built, via add_subdirectory(PoissonShapeAnalysis). I found no network access, downloads, pip installs, shell execution or other safety or environment concerns. The Slicer BSD-style license permits distribution. build_dependencies is empty, which matches EXTENSION_DEPENDS "NA". Findings are minor: the entry pins scm_revision to the moving branch "main", an unused "jjj" scaffold module is committed, the CLI test appears broken, and error handling uses abort/SIGABRT. The solver .hxx files were not read in full. Recommend merge.
not_checked: <parameter name="0">The solver files (SumOfTwoPoissonShapeAnalysis.hxx and the other lib/*.hxx numerical code) were only searched for dangerous calls, not read in full.
